dependencies.sharedSourceNote: STANDALONE codec: no renz.py profile and no shared source. The crypto structure and XXTEA delta (0x7a56d3e1) match the shared RENZ route, but PASSWORD, FIXED_SALT and IV differ from every RENZ_KEYS entry (e.g. gcpvpn), so the shared profile cannot open this catalog. Nothing under android/ changes. PM Tunnel Lite stays online-only, no offline port.

files.note: The .js suffix is deliberately NOT registered in file-formats.json / engine.py _C8_FILE_ENGINES (see status.md §2): .js is generic, the file catalog dispatches purely by longest filename suffix with no content detection, and registering js would route EVERY .js upload to this decoder. file_decoder.py implements .js / custom_payload.json decoding for direct and CLI use; the integrated routes are the live catalog and pmtunnellite://.
files.validation: Standalone codec (no renz.py registration); synthetic fixtures for .js catalog, custom_payload.json and pmtunnellite:// round-trips (see dossier RESULTS.md scenarios 11-12 and tests/test_pmtunnel.py). No independent real export or Android roundtrip.
